mechanism: Isotretinoin is highly teratogenic and requires strict pregnancy prevention; sertraline may increase suicidal ideation risk in younger patients, and isotretinoin also carries psychiatric adverse effects including depression and suicidality.
action: Monitor closely for psychiatric symptoms and suicidal ideation; ensure strict contraception in females of childbearing potential; consider alternative antidepressant or dermatological therapy if risk outweighs benefit.
